title: The Root Chamber of Asking

features.name: house-with-question-windows
features.desc-on-touch: A tiny cottage rendered in block shapes, but every window is a question mark. The house is built around the asking, not the answering.

features.name: root-through-circuitry
features.desc-on-touch: A root has grown through the circuit board substrate. It asks the board questions; the board answers in sparks and broken traces.

features.name: question-shaped-tree
features.desc-on-touch: If you read the branches as an outline, they form the shape of a question mark. The trunk splits into two paths that never meet.

features.name: stack-of-unanswered-scrolls
features.desc-on-touch: Each scroll is a question that grew deeper as it was asked. The stack is very tall. The questions keep unrolling downward into unseen chambers.

features.name: doorways-framing-inquiries
features.desc-on-touch: Five arches, each one rendering a different kind of asking. One asks with hope. One asks with suspicion. One asks and immediately forgets its question.

inscription: questions are the archive's first root; they ask downward toward answers that refuse to settle

file.name: Root_System_Interrogative_Mapping.txt
file.note: An attempt to diagram the root structure as a question-and-answer system. Incomplete. The roots keep growing past the margin of the page.

exits.label: back up toward the axiom that started all asking
down to where questions become answers that are also questions
into the root-dark where doubt learned its first word
